meaning: Calm, peaceful, and free from worry.
example: The lake looks serene in the early morning.
note_say: The stress is on the second syllable. The end rhymes with green.
mean_say: calm, peaceful, and free from worry.
ex_say: The lake looks serene in the early morning.
tip: Similar words: calm, peaceful. Noun: serenity.
vn_tip: Nhấn vào âm thứ hai: se-RENE. Đừng đọc đều hai âm như tiếng Việt.
vn_tip_say: Don't say both parts the same. Push the second part: se, RENE.
